title: Give blocked users a second download origin (mirror failover)
description: Enable the shipped-but-inert mirror. Origin pivoted 2026-08-03 from a second Cloudflare hostname (dropped - a young uncategorised domain, so a second subdomain does not dodge domain-level filtering) to Hugging Face. R2 stays primary on both engines; the mirror is local-only by construction, so Pod speed cannot regress. Phase 1 classifies all 97 R2-hosted deps (400.8 GB) by SHA256 against their upstream - only byte-identical blobs can be mirrored externally - and its re-host total picks the HF tier. Plan in checklist.md.
